note: MCB Bonaire: a resident's current account carries a monthly administration fee of 1.50 dollars (before ABB tax, which isn't modelled). The waiver for residents of 65 and over needs a pension paid into the account and an application, so the game charges the fee.

sources.title: MCB Bonaire, Branch Services & Fees
sources.said: CURRENT ACCOUNT FEE Monthly administration fee resident $1.50 ... 65+ Resident Pension Current Accounts** (Resident Pension Accounts for individuals aged 65 and over) and Student Accounts are exempt from the above monthly administration fees of US$ 1.50 excl. ABB.
